summary: Cardiff Lexington Corp filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026 disclosing a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a multi-location musculoskeletal healthcare platform, furnished via press release (Exhibit 99.1). The OTC-listed healthcare holding company (OTC: CDIX) is the acquirer; the target remains unnamed, operating clinics across multiple states. No purchase price, share consideration, premium, financing, or closing timeline was disclosed, so deal economics are indeterminate. The company frames the combination as expanding its orthopedic, spine, pain, imaging, and physical therapy platform. Because the pact is only an LOI, material definitive terms, board approval, financing, and regulatory review remain outstanding. Watch for a definitive agreement, consideration structure, and any equity issuance or dilution risk.
